new_empirical_findings: CD169 raw EM12 depth residual magnitude is strongly across-track dependent.
Absolute residuals become materially larger toward OUTER and EXTREME beams in both independent 2008 comparisons and both tested CD169 raw lineages.
Residual distribution is heavy-tailed; >=100 m events are observed but rare and calibration-channel dependent.
A fixed line32/port deep bias is falsified: extreme-beam population medians are generally shallow relative to the 2008 references while rare positive deep outliers also exist.
CAND003 CELL_A/B are rare positive deep outliers within the extreme-beam heavy tail; their approximately 186-199 m raw split is not explained by sub-cell spatial separation.
For synthetic calibration, uniform Gaussian depth noise is empirically inadequate for CD169-like EM12 replay.
validation_requirement: Different unseen raw multibeam survey with independent corrected or later reference surface; freeze target survey and scoring before result inspection.
forbidden_transfer: CD169 empirical tail frequency as a universal probability
specific line18/line32 identity as a universal sensor state
